blind.description: A carved greenish-grey stone mortuary or embalming table with drainage channels. It consists of a thick rectangular slab top with raised lip edges, a raised headrest block at one end, carved drainage grooves in a leaf/herringbone pattern leading to a drainage spout/channel at the foot end. The top rests upon two thick square carved stone pedestal legs with blind gothic arch detailing. Surfaces are solid, continuous, and clean with stylized hand-painted textures; no unattached, melted, or floating geometry.
blind.from_above: A rectangular stone tray-like slab with raised rims, a rectangular raised headrest block on the left end, an outlet notch/spout on the right end, and carved branched drainage channels across the sunken flat bed.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2 ft high), and roughly as long as the figure is tall (approx. 5.5 to 6 ft long).
